mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CD.ID, CD.LABEL, CD.ISCHILDREN, CD.PATH, CD.ICON, CD.PARENTID, CD.DELFLAG, CD.MODULE_ID, CD.MENU_LV, CD.CREATE_TIME, CD.CREATE_USER, CD.UPDATE_TIME, CD.UPDATE_USER, CD.SORT FROM dataflowdb.DIC_USER U INNER JOIN dataflowdb.DIC_USER_CHARGE GX ON U.ID=GX.USER_ID INNER JOIN dataflowdb.sys_role_detail QXMX ON GX.ROLE_ID=QXMX.ROLE_ID INNER JOIN dataflowdb.MENU CD ON QXMX.MENU_ID=CD.ID INNER JOIN dataflowdb.SYS_MODULE MK ON CD.MODULE_ID=MK.MODULE_ID AND CD.DELFLAG='0' and gx.del_flag='0' and qxmx.del_flag='0' AND CD.MENU_LV='1' AND U.ID=#{userId} AND MK.MODULE_ID = #{moduleId} ORDER BY CD.SORT

SELECT DISTINCT CD.ID, CD.LABEL, CD.ISCHILDREN, CD.PATH, CD.ICON, CD.PARENTID, CD.DELFLAG, CD.MODULE_ID, CD.MENU_LV, CD.CREATE_TIME, CD.CREATE_USER, CD.UPDATE_TIME, CD.UPDATE_USER, CD.SORT FROM dataflowdb.DIC_USER U INNER JOIN dataflowdb.DIC_USER_CHARGE GX ON U.ID = GX.USER_ID INNER JOIN dataflowdb.sys_role_detail QXMX ON GX.ROLE_ID = QXMX.ROLE_ID INNER JOIN dataflowdb.MENU CD ON QXMX.MENU_ID = CD.ID INNER JOIN dataflowdb.SYS_MODULE MK ON CD.MODULE_ID = MK.MODULE_ID AND CD.DELFLAG = '0' and gx.del_flag = '0' and qxmx.del_flag = '0' AND CD.MENU_LV <> '1' AND U.ID = #{userId} AND CD.PARENTID = #{parentId} ORDER BY CD.SORT
